title: Steamboat pursues Stunning Steve Austin
summary: Steve Austin tries to outsmart the veteran who once opposed the Hollywood Blonds. Their United States title rivalry pits opportunism against Steamboat’s persistence.

chapters.title: Austin steals the advantage
chapters.result: Austin defeats Steamboat to retain the United States title.
chapters.context: Using the ropes for leverage lets Austin escape a technically demanding challenge.

chapters.title: Steamboat wins the championship back
chapters.result: Steamboat defeats Austin for the United States title.
chapters.context: The rematch gives the veteran the title victory denied him the previous month.
